title: Peanut Tofu and Coconut Rice
subtitle: with Pickled Cucumber Salad
description: Whether you're a vegan, vegetarian or simply looking to eat less meat, this hearty bowl hits the spot. Brown rice cooks with coconut for a tasty twist, while satay tofu roasts in the oven until golden.

steps.text: Cook coconut rice: Preheat the oven to 220C. Line an oven tray with baking paper (see Make it faster). Fill a medium saucepan three-quarters full with water and bring to the boil. Add the rice and coconut and cook for 25 mins or until the rice is tender. Drain.

Roast tofu: Meanwhile, put the tofu on the lined tray and roast, turning halfway, for 20 mins or until crisp and golden. Peel the cucumber into ribbons with a vegetable peeler. Peel the carrot, then shred with a julienne peeler or coarsely grate with a box grater. Coarsely chop the peanuts.

Pickle vegetables: Put 1 tbs white vinegar and 1 tbs sugar in a large bowl and stir until the sugar dissolves. Add the cucumber and carrot and toss well to combine. Set aside to pickle, tossing occasionally, until needed.

Blanch snow peas: Trim the stems from the snow peas, removing the strings from one side. Put in a bowl and cover with boiling water. Stand for 5 mins or until tender but still with crunch. Drain. Drain the pickled vegetables, reserving the pickling liquid.
Serve up: Divide the coconut rice, tofu, pickled vegetables and snow peas among bowls. Drizzle with the pickling liquid and 2 tbs soy sauce, then scatter over the peanuts. Enjoy!
Make it faster: If you don't want to turn the oven on to roast the tofu (in Step 2), simply pan-fry the tofu in a little oil for 2-3 mins each side until golden and warmed through.
